english.title: Cause / permit vehicle to be left unattended without handbrake being set at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be left unattended at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport without the parking brake or restraining device with which the vehicle was equipped being properly engaged
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(5) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
